meta.source: LauzHack 2026 synthetic dataset: synthetic-transactions.zip, synthetic-profiles.csv, synthetic-cash-balances.csv
meta.model: flow = Bernoulli(probability(x)) * amount(x) * basis; probability and amount are multiplicative in the selected features; unknown levels use factor 1
caveats: Synthetic data: the model recovers the generator, not real behaviour.
The ledger has no trend (2026 = 2025): growth of wages, rents and prices comes from macro.json.
Loan payments and asset returns are not in the ledger: they are engine rules and assumptions.
The 'tuition' flow is the observed cost of the dataset students; events must not add it twice.
